segmentation.text: If the driver of a vehicle
and: The turn is a right turn,
both the approach for the right turn and the right turn must be made from the right turn lane
if the highway has a right turn lane
as set forth in subsection 4 of NRS 484B.223 [NRS-484B-223-4a, NRS-484B-223-4b],
or must be made from the extreme right lane.

elements.justification: 'a vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, as the mapping index maps 'The driver of a vehicle'; 'the driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion.

The intersection is the region the intention is declared at and the vehicle enters: a st.intersection, anchored by the carrier x occupies (rel.occupies) of kind st.travel_region whose entrance end is that intersection (st.lane_enters).

The highway has a right turn lane 'as set forth in subsection 4', whose words are 'If a highway has been designed to provide a single right lane to be used only for turning': a st.turn_lane of side right that is the rightmost lane of its direction (st.lane_adjacency, ordinal equal to count) on (st.on_way) the highway (st.highway) of the carrier x occupies (rel.occupies), entering the intersection x enters (st.lane_enters, st.intersection). This node applies where the highway has none (the 'or' of the words).

The extreme right lane is the st.lane ('a longitudinal strip of roadway for one line of vehicles') whose ordinal equals the count of lanes in its direction (st.lane_adjacency: 'ordinal 1 is the leftmost lane, looking along the lane's direction'); the turn is made from it when, at the observation before the entry, the carrier x occupies (rel.occupies) that enters the intersection (st.lane_enters, st.intersection) is that lane. Not a stand-in for a lateral offset: lane membership is the lane x occupies, not its distance to the edge.

intentions.meaning: The road user's current plan includes a right turn at the target region.
The road user's current plan includes a right turn at the target region.

compositions.quote: If a highway has been designed to provide a single right lane to be used only for turning
compositions.why: Borrows the qualifiers 'single', 'right lane' and 'to be used only for turning', which set forth what the highway's right turn lane is; this duty needs only that such a lane exists, and whether subsection 4's own duty (driving in that lane only to turn right) applies or is complied with decides nothing here.

compositions.quote: If a highway has been designed to provide a single right lane to be used only for turning
compositions.why: Borrows the same qualifiers from the same opening words of subsection 4; this duty needs only that such a lane exists, and whether subsection 4's own duty (not travelling through an intersection from that lane) applies or is complied with decides nothing here.

applicability: x is a member of DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle that enters an intersection i at the judged observation (rel.occupies(x, i) rises), with int.turn_right(x, i) declared true at that observation; and the highway has no right turn lane: at the observation before the entry no st.turn_lane of side right that enters i, lies on the highway of a carrier x occupies entering i, and is the rightmost lane of its direction (st.lane_adjacency ordinal equal to count) exists.
obligation: At the observation before the entry, x occupies a st.lane l with st.lane_enters(l, i) whose st.lane_adjacency ordinal equals the count of lanes in its direction, and every lane x occupies there that enters i is such a lane. Violated where x enters i with its intention to turn right from a lane entering i that is not the extreme right lane.

narrowings.why: The turn is judged at the observation before the entry, by the lane through which x approaches the intersection then; an approach on a roadway without marked lanes, where no lane ordinal exists, leaves the extreme right lane unknown.
'the driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: On a two-lane approach without a right turn lane, a car with int.turn_right declared at the intersection enters it from the lane of ordinal 1 of 2.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: The same car enters the intersection from the lane of ordinal 2 of 2.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The approach has a right turn lane entering the intersection; the extreme-right-lane requirement does not apply.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: A car with int.turn_right enters from one of two lanes; the source does not supply lane ordinals.
